rules.rule: Assign the selected issue to yourself before starting work on it.
Create a worktree branch for the issue before implementing it.
Have the QA agent verify all acceptance criteria are met before a PR is opened.
Have the review agent check code quality before a PR is opened.
Run the migration with --dry-run in Azure mode before running it for real.
Read the screen behavior docs for a screen before reviewing or seeding that screen.
Always read a file before editing it, regardless of what memory says about it.
For regular development work, never run `npm run dev` or any local Vite dev server.
Read AGENTS.md before any cross-tool invocation.
Do not pursue further SPY systematic options refinement, since that area is considered settled.
Refine the inverse-squeeze short straddle TP50 strategy before deploying it as a sleeve.
In the next session, do not re-verify the budget event structure; it was already confirmed clean as of 2026-04-24.
Do not re-verify whether the Korea trip savings events exist in PocketSmith; they have already been confirmed live.
Before deploying any "skip month X" or "buy month Y" trading claim, validate it with a Bonferroni-corrected test.
Before deploying any "skip month X" or "buy month Y" trading claim, validate it with a split-sample test.
Do not deploy the long-strangle book, because it is not yet deployable.
Do not switch the trading-tools repo to the `main` branch; use `master`.
Do not perform max sprints or depth jumps until the readiness gates pass.
Do not automatically activate the travel domain; wait until Scott asks to activate it.
Do not add the travel domain to the top-level PLAIOS CLAUDE.md domains table unless Scott explicitly requests it.
Do not run a parallel rs_vol sleeve alongside the SPY_top_5 strategy.
Do not run `git push` unless the user explicitly asks for it.
Do not make repository changes (such as editing cli.py or writing decision records and studies) without Scott's explicit go-ahead.
Delete the temporary file D:\PLAIOS\bundle.md only after Scott gives the go-ahead.
Perform an upload or scheduling action only when Bryan explicitly requests it in chat for that one specific upload, and treat that permission as covering only that upload.
Keep the user's real file untouched until all changes are verified in the scratchpad.
Before regex-fixing text in a .pptx file, dump the raw run XML of the target paragraphs first.
When Bryan asks for a copy of a file, offer any fill-in of its contents as a separate step and wait for his explicit yes before doing it.
For the animate skill, always run build.mjs before export.mjs.
Before building any new skill, tool, script, or small app from scratch, search GitHub (and Hugging Face for models/agents) for an existing one first.
Never connect Higgsfield without Bryan's explicit yes.
Never log in to Higgsfield without Bryan's explicit yes.
Audit a good-fit tool before installing it.
Ask before installing any tool found in the search.
For any request to make a skill, tool, or script, make the search the first step.
In a film chat, stop once at the every=3 board, wait for Bryan's approval, then render.
Never upload films.
Never place animation pieces in the JARVIS repo.
Before building an Excel file, run one feasibility test that covers every formatting trick the design relies on.
Do not start building a PowerPoint presentation for the Bahasa Inggris presentation project until the user explicitly asks for it.
Ask for the grading rubric before submitting any Bahasa Inggris project or assignment.
Read the existing artifact first in a new session before republishing it.
Before replacing Bryan's file, check that it is not open by looking for its ~$ lock file.
Before replacing Bryan's file, check that it is byte-identical to your backup.
Do not move the GP-100 editor installed at C:\Bryan De Great\GP-100\, because its shortcuts point there.
Before rebuilding the kaos boards with `buat_kaos.py`, move existing same-named output files to `_Arsip\` so they are not overwritten.
Don't commit the sekitar skill to git until Bryan asks.
Don't commit the riset-sekitar skill to git until Bryan asks.
Schedule uploads one at a time; never bulk-post.
Don't post a first comment on a scheduled upload until it is live.
